nepal.title: The river changed everything.
nepal.subtitle: Budhi Gandaki flash flood · A changing record of crossings, warnings and essential water systems.
nepal.overview: A date-stamped exploration of a serious flood event and its reported impacts. Information shown here is from public-source research, not Evercraft field verification.

milestones.label: Early local warning
milestones.detail: A witness reported receiving an upstream warning at 04:45. This is a reported recollection, not a verified instrument time.

milestones.label: Estimated landslide time
milestones.detail: An NDRRMA situation report estimated a major landslide at 05:30. Event time and warning-receipt times require separate verification.

milestones.label: Water through blockage
milestones.detail: The cited NDRRMA chronology places water emerging through the blockage at approximately 06:15. The causal mechanism remained subject to investigation.

milestones.label: Gauge reading at Arughat
milestones.detail: A public-source summary of the report records an 8.43 m level at about 08:40. Source and instrument timestamps require preservation.

milestones.label: Lifelines review
milestones.detail: A later working brief collated 204 reportedly damaged homes and 11 drinking-water scheme entries. These are not independently geolocated facilities.

features.label: Crossings
features.detail: Two concrete, two suspension and one Bailey bridge occur in NDRRMA categorization. At least six place-name entries appear in local reporting. They are NOT a verified unique crossing count. No coordinates or route status are asserted.

features.label: Water schemes
features.detail: Water system names can denote aliases, aggregate descriptions, or physical networks. These locations are schematic. No contamination or restoration status is inferred.

features.label: Housing
features.detail: The October 11 NDRRMA reporting, summarized October 12, cites damaged homes by municipality. Do not equate with destroyed homes or add to separate counts.

sources.name: Nepal NDRRMA situation-report portal
sources.note: Agency reporting; review the original dated report for each data point.

sources.name: ICIMOD, preliminary flood explanation
sources.note: Preliminary hypothesis, not independently proven causation.

sources.name: Kathmandu Post, warning chronology
sources.note: Reports multiple witness and official timestamps with different meaning.

sources.name: Evercraft Nepal 002 lifelines working brief
sources.note: Candidate research register, not an authorized field/route assessment.

sources.name: United Nations Nepal, flood statement
sources.note: Describes imagery coordination; it does not grant imagery reuse rights.

nepal.caution: No field verification. No live travel or route guidance. Symbolic visualization only. Source dates and observation dates must be distinguished.

helens.title: A mountain in motion.
helens.subtitle: Mount St. Helens · From seismic warnings to landslide, lateral blast and ash cloud.
helens.overview: A demonstration of how measured timelines and documentary evidence could power a visually navigable historical science lesson. The landscape is an artistic schematic, not an eruption model.

milestones.label: Activity intensifies
milestones.detail: Earthquakes and deformation signaled volcanic unrest. USGS documents more than 10,000 earthquakes before May 18.

milestones.label: Magnitude 5.1 earthquake
milestones.detail: A magnitude 5.1 earthquake coincided with the failure of the bulging north flank.

milestones.label: Debris avalanche
milestones.detail: The northern flank and summit slid away in what USGS describes as the largest recorded landslide of its kind.

milestones.label: Lateral blast
milestones.detail: Pressure release triggered a lateral blast, devastating approximately 230 square miles. This illustration is not a physics simulation.

milestones.label: Ash cloud rises
milestones.detail: USGS reports an ash plume exceeding 80,000 feet within 15 minutes. Ash traveled across large portions of the United States.

features.label: North flank
features.detail: On May 18, a landslide removed the bulging north flank and initiated a chain of eruptive processes. Exact deposit footprints are not reproduced here.

features.label: Lateral blast
features.detail: The blast devastated an estimated 230 square miles. The illustrated effect is artistic only, not a spatial analysis of the actual blast.

features.label: Lahars
features.detail: Volcanic mudflows traveled downstream and damaged roads, bridges and homes. Routes drawn here are not actual lahar pathways.

sources.name: USGS: 30 Cool Facts about Mount St. Helens

helens.caution: Historical event. Animated topography and particle effects are conceptual, not measured 3D terrain, actual ash advection, or hazard boundaries.

yakima.title: The water behind the valley.
yakima.subtitle: Yakima Basin drought · Follow snowpack, storage and the decisions that shape irrigation.
yakima.overview: A proposed local-impact exhibit connecting dated water forecasts with their social and economic implications. It does not predict crop outcomes or individual water rights.

milestones.label: Low snowpack
milestones.detail: Reclamation attributed a fourth consecutive drought year in part to winter snowpack less than half of normal.

milestones.label: Proration begins
milestones.detail: The Yakima Basin Project began prorationing and storage control on May 21, 2026. This does not describe every individual water entitlement.

milestones.label: Storage snapshot
milestones.detail: Reclamation reported total reservoir storage at 605,000 acre-feet, 57% full, and 80% of average on August 1.

milestones.label: Forecast published
milestones.detail: The Bureau of Reclamation reported that irrigation demands would not be fully met that season. The forecast is a dated August statement.

features.label: Snowpack
features.short: Below half of normal in winter
features.detail: Snowpack conditions were a major drought driver in the August report. Scene markers are thematic, not surveyed snow stations.

features.label: Storage
features.detail: August 1 reservoir storage: 605,000 acre-feet (57% full), or 80% of average. Not a live reading.

features.label: Irrigation
features.detail: Proration allocations are governed by water rights and project rules. No crop-loss number or farm-specific shortage is inferred.

sources.name: Bureau of Reclamation: Aug 2026 Yakima forecast
sources.note: Authoritative dated forecast, not a real-time water-status feed.

yakima.caution: Dated agency snapshot, not current conditions. No property-level water-right interpretations, farm-level estimates or live irrigation guidance.
